Agent Name: Planner
 Step Number: 9
 Reason for Mistake: The Planner relied on a search-result snippet and asserted that the Svensk Filmdatabas page stated Gustaf Molander was born in Helsingborg, Sweden, without opening and verifying the actual page content. Authoritative sources (SBL and later the SFdb snippet itself) indicate Helsingfors/Helsinki, Finland. This premature, unverified conclusion introduced a wrong birthplace and led to unnecessary confusion.
